door.add_intro: Give {taf} an address people can write to. It has none until you turn one on, and its Card still decides what it does.
door.bot_still_listens: The bot still listens, so the door stays. {why}
door.checks_sender_server_signed_message: It checks the sender's server signed the message

door.day.open.one: {today} of {count} from you and paired senders today. Text only: attachments aren't opened, and the reply says so.
door.day.open.other: {today} of {count} from you and paired senders today. Text only: attachments aren't opened, and the reply says so.

door.day.resting.one: {count} of {count} from you and paired senders today. More are dropped until tomorrow.
door.day.resting.other: {count} of {count} from you and paired senders today. More are dropped until tomorrow.

door.do_it.default: Do what it asks, within your Card.
door.do_it.intro: {who|possessive} message goes with your words, as information. {taf} acts on what you say, within its Card, and doesn't write back to them unless you ask.
door.do_it.intro_it: {who|possessive} message goes with your words, as information. It acts on what you say, within its Card, and doesn't write back to them unless you ask.
door.do_it.title: Tell {taf} what to do
door.do_it.title_your_taf: Tell your taf what to do
door.doors_turn_pick_press_open: Doors · turn to pick, press to open
door.footer: Anyone can write to a door. Only people you pair can give {taf} work, and its Card decides the rest.
door.hi_like_back_order: Hi, I'd like $15 back on order T-3001.
door.key.foot: {how}. A message counts as theirs only when that holds; anyone else knocks.
door.key.none: {how}, so no one here can give {taf} work. Everything that comes through knocks.
door.knock.paired_line: Paired · Do it or Ignore this message
door.knock.proof_failed: It says it's from {from}, but it didn't pass the sender check, so it's treated as a stranger's.
door.knock.proof_none: This door can't prove who wrote it.

door.knock.rest_keys.one: This door had its messages from you and paired senders for today. {count} more was dropped.
door.knock.rest_keys.other: This door had its messages from you and paired senders for today. {count} more were dropped.

door.knock.rest_others.one: This door had its messages from people who aren't paired for today. {count} more was dropped.
door.knock.rest_others.other: This door had its messages from people who aren't paired for today. {count} more were dropped.

door.knock.too_many: That's a lot of messages in a few minutes. Wait a little, then send it again: nothing was sent.
door.no_door_yet: {taf} has no door yet. Someone who manages it can add one.
door.no_more: No more doors can be added here.
door.not_read: The doors couldn't be read just now. They're tried again when you come back here.
door.pair_hint.phone: Phone number, with its country code
door.pair_hint.slack: Slack member ID, such as U012AB3CD
door.pair_intro: Their messages to this {door} door give work, within the Card. Anyone else's only knock.
door.paired_senders_today_more_dropped: {limit} of {limit_2} from you and paired senders today. More are dropped until tomorrow.
door.paired_senders_today_text_only: {today} of {limit} from you and paired senders today. Text only: attachments aren't opened, and the reply says so.
door.proven_section: Knows who's writing · can hold keys
door.remove_body: Its address stops being {taf|possessive}. Messages already in its chat stay.
door.replies_only: Replies go only to who wrote. Anything else the taf does still goes through KIFF.
door.slack.connect_first: Connect the Slack bot for this taf first, in Settings › Connect apps. Then add its channel here.
door.slack.connect_first_in_connect_apps: Connect the Slack bot for {taf} first, in Connect apps. Then add its door here.
door.slack.no_account: This Slack connection isn't ready yet. Try again in a moment.
door.slack.no_channels: The Slack bot can't see any channel yet. Add it to a channel in Slack, then try again.
door.slack.which_bot: Which Slack connection is it for?
door.slack.which_channel: Which channel does it answer in? New messages there will start work.
door.slack_bot_sees_no_channel: The Slack bot sees no channel yet. Invite it to one in Slack, then come back.
door.slack_cant_listen: The Slack bot couldn't listen to that channel. {why}
door.slack_still_listens: The Slack bot still listens to that channel, so the door stays. {why}
door.slack_subscription_not_stopped_door: Slack's subscription wasn't stopped, so the door stays: {why}
door.start_connected_tools_first_slack: Start from Connected apps on this {device} first. Slack's subscription must be stopped before removing its door.
door.swipe_up_down_pick_door: Swipe up or down to pick a door. Double-tap to open or close it.
door.unproven_section: Can't prove who's writing · knocks only
door.whatsapp_android: Adding a WhatsApp door isn't in the Android app yet. Add it from tafs on an iPhone.
door.whatsapp_elsewhere: WhatsApp doors are added from tafs on an iPhone for now; once added, they show here.
